description: Returns which economic operator can be the EU responsible person for a consumer product under GPSR Article 16 and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Article 4: the manufacturer in the EU, the EU importer, an EU authorised representative, or an EU fulfilment service provider where none of the others exists. Input: where the manufacturer is established and which of these operators exist. It also states what the online listing shows about that person, with official sources. It does not check a specific product or appoint anyone.

authorised_representative.description: Whether the manufacturer has appointed an authorised representative in the EU by written mandate

eu_fulfilment_service_provider.description: Whether a fulfilment service provider established in the EU handles the product

eu_importer.description: Whether an importer established in the EU places the product on the EU market (for example a shop in the EU that buys the product from a non-EU maker)

manufacturer_established_in_eu.description: Whether the manufacturer of the product is established in the EU

name: gpsr_responsible_person
title: Find the GPSR responsible person
